This is a geometric series with the first term \(\frac{1}{j^2}\) and common ratio \(\frac{1}{j}\):
\[ \sum_{k=2}^{\infty} \frac{1}{j^k} = \frac{\frac{1}{j^2}}{1 - \frac{1}{j}} = \frac{\frac{1}{j^2}}{\frac{j-1}{j}} = \frac{1}{j(j-1)}.
sentence-category-reason: Identifies the inner sum as a geometric series and computes its closed form.
